newsitem.title: USA: ProSource ends Arby's deal, sees charge.
newsitem.headline: ProSource ends Arby's deal, sees charge.

text.p: ProSource Inc said on Friday that it will discontinue distribution services to Triarc Cos Inc unit Arby's on April 1, 1997, which is expected to result in a pre-tax charge of $10 million.
Distribution services to Arby's represented sales of approximately $400 million, or 10 percent of revenues for the year ended December 28, 1996, ProSource said.
The charge stems from severance costs and termination of equipment leases, said ProSource, which will report fourth quarter results on or about February 12, 1997.
